messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — billing.metering.token-delta exceeded threshold for multiple customers :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Alert details: detector=token-delta, window=5m, nodes=[cg1,cg2,eu1], sample_count=120, flags=overage_candidates
sre-oncall: acked and joining. linking logs now. any customer-visible alerts yet?
alex.k: we see a spike in emitted token counts vs ledger by ~30% starting 02:10 UTC. Not all customers, looks clustered on cg1 and eu1.
priya.m: checking consumer lag on kafka -> consumer-group metering-emit shows lag ~0. consumer offsets jumping, but emitter upstream shows bursts.
billing-eng: are these real tokens or duplicate replays? quick grep of emitter IDs shows repeated request_ids for some customers. could be retry storms from proxies.
support-lead: we have 4 incoming escalation tickets from customers about unexpected overage emails. marking as potential false positives for now.
sre-oncall: run quick sanity: tail last 50 rows of token-agg for affected tenant t-42

alex.k: ```
2026-03-17T02:11:03Z tenant=t-42 event=emit id=rcv_0x9f1a count=512
2026-03-17T02:11:04Z tenant=t-42 event=emit id=rcv_0x9f1a count=512
2026-03-17T02:11:05Z tenant=t-42 event=ack id=rcv_0x9f1a status=duplicated
```

priya.m: looks like emitter duplicated batches; kafka acks delayed then replayed. consumer dedupe should prevent double counting but dedupe window had been shortened in last deploy (ramp config).
billing-eng: that config change was intended to reduce memory footprint. damn. reconcile window was reduced from 5m -> 30s in 2026-03-17 01:50 rollout.
sre-oncall: rollback candidate: restore dedupe_window to 5m, restart metering-consumer on cg1 and eu1. can we hotfix without full restart?
alex.k: we can flip a feature flag to extend dedupe TTL in runtime; pushing patch now to metering-config-service. will apply to cg1 and eu1 first.

incident-bot: Deploy triggered by alex.k: metering-config-service v2.14 -> set dedupe_window=300s on cg1 (rollout step 1).

priya.m: patch applied to cg1 and eu1. monitoring: token-delta falling back to baseline within ~40s.
sre-oncall: good. still need to reconcile counts for the window where duplicates were counted as unique. billing-eng: how many customers impacted and overage flags fired?
billing-eng: initial estimate: ~120 customers had transient overage flags; most were for small bursts. a small cohort (~8) show large deltas (>10k tokens) and were auto-notified.
support-lead: will pause automated overage emails and apply manual review tag to these 8 customers while we reconcile. please confirm when pause is active.

sre-oncall: paused email senders at 02:17 UTC.
billing-eng: plan for reconciliation: 1) compute duplicate candidates by request_id in window 02:10-02:16 2) subtract dupe tokens from emitted tallies -> produce corrected ledger 3) emit credits where needed and retract erroneous overage flags.

alex.k: I'll run step 1 and post results.
alex.k: duplicate request_id count ~14,300 tokens across all impacted customers; top 10 tenants account for ~9,800 tokens.
billing-eng: that's within expected range. proceed with ledger correction. I'll run the correction job in dry-run and paste sample diff.

billing-eng: ```
tenant t-42: reported=12512 corrected=7360 delta=-5152
tenant t-99: reported=4020 corrected=4020 delta=0
```

billing-eng: dry-run matches expectations. scheduling actual ledger patch in 10m (after further validations). will apply credits and retract overage flags for affected accounts.
support-lead: notifying account managers and drafting customer comms: will say "false-positive overage emails due to replication/retry storm; root cause identified; credits applied where appropriate."

sre-oncall: postmortem TODOs: - revert dedupe_window change in config repo with revert PR - add canary gating on dedupe config changes - extend monitoring to detect config rollbacks' side effects - add automated reconciliation job when dedupe window is shortened - run tabletop with billing/support on false-positive playbook

incident-bot: Severity reduced to MED; incident will remain open for follow-up.
sre-oncall: thanks team. I'll keep watch for 30m and then handoff to morning shift. leaving notes in incident board. :thumbsup:
